profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Dell
profile.summary:
I am currently a Software Engineer at Dell Technologies working in the Infrastructure Solutions Group as part of their new grad SE rotation program. 

Through my experiences, I have built strong communication and analytical skills that have made me very adaptable. I am able to understand subjects quickly and communicate that understanding at a high-level language. I love learning and am receptive and quick to apply feedback when provided. I am also working on building my technical skills to better suit the tech industry.

As a first generation college student, there is much I have still to learn about navigating the professional space, so I am always open to feedback.

positions.title: Security Access Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Diagramed existing processes within complex software stacks in storage solutions
•	Containerized postgres databases using docker alongside REST server and data migration tools
•	Isolated and implemented interaction/entry points between docker container and existing software stack 
•	Designed recovery/backup system for containerized databases to replace existing one

positions.title: Terry Scholar
positions.description: Selected for a full ride scholarship to The University of Texas at Austin from a pool of over 10,000 applicants

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Learned about edge technology through 20+ hours of training workshops on Telit deviceWISE solutions
•	Worked with new Dell Edge gateways to install deviceWISE solutions on Ubuntu 20.02
•	Created a quickstart guide for installation of edge software on new gateway devices 
•	Leading coffee chats for interns under the Latino Connections Recruiting ERG

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
•	Oversaw development and implementation of new HBSA mobile application 
•	Crowdfunded over $5,000 dollars towards our annual Día De Los Muertos Festival 
•	Organized a Día De Los Muertos festival in collaboration with 8 other Student Organizations and 1000+ student attendance
•	Manage technical logistics for over 120 events throughout 2021-2022 academic year

positions.title: Services Sales Intern at Dell Technologies
positions.description:
• Pitched Dell Technologies services and solutions weekly to managers and Sales Reps
• Managed a team of interns in creating a OneNote that organized all the different teams within an ERG
• Presented our findings about LatinoConnections recruiting to executives

positions.title: Online Learning Facilitator
positions.description: Provide technical support through zoom for instructors and students in professional education classes at UT Austin

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: HBSA Scoring Careers Committee Chair
positions.description:
•	Organized Scoring Careers career expo to aid students in networking for summer opportunities or future employment
•	Communicated with companies to form corporate relations and increased company attendance by over 100% compared to previous year
•	Marketed Scoring Careers within the McCombs School of Business by presenting in classes and other organizations
•	Organized over 7 events in the span of a week as Executive Vice President during Officer for a Week along with council

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
•	Facilitated complex mathematical topics to 100+ students in order to help them develop a fundamental understanding of topics
•	Managed online tutoring sessions for Elementary Statistics on the UTRGV Website for university students
•	Administered and aided students in various mathematical subjects for walk in tutoring at the learning center
•	Oversaw 4 workshops for Elementary Statistics Classes upon student request or approaching exam dates

company.name: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

positions.title: Seasonal Retail Cashier
positions.description: Assisted customers in cashing and packaging purchases while maintaining a lively and welcoming atmosphere

positions.title: McCombs Future Executive Academy
positions.description:
•	Influenced Briggo’s application of a loyalty rewards system that is meant to generate a constant customer base
•	Presented our marketing pitch in front of select McCombs Faculty, Briggo’s president, and marketing experts
•	Participated and won in a group marketing challenge that involved the Austin based coffee company Briggo
